reproduction.expected: An installed Customer Agent Starter can receive a bounded structured workspace mutation, create an exact-scope local Git commit, create an exact-head GitHub pull request, and wait for CI through one assembled Provider registry without fake success.
reproduction.actual: Workspace mutation has no adapter, local Git and code-review adapters depend on fake-only host implementations, and Starter runtime embedding has no concrete Provider bootstrap.

violated_invariants: An activated mutating capability must execute through a real bounded Provider implementation after the existing Write Authority Guard.
A commit receipt must prove the exact parent SHA and exact changed path set from a real repository.
A pull-request receipt must prove the requested repository, branches, and exact head SHA from the remote provider.
Missing Host credentials or Provider effects must block rather than produce simulated evidence.
